title: The Drowned Sigil
author: Quentin Fairweather
blurb: Mirabel Villalobos, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
